Done. Committed `docs/competitor-ui-research.md` at `56e58ef`.

**Summary of findings across 4 competitors:**

**HailTrace (storm mapping):** 1-5 star storm ratings, purple overlap zones for highest damage, right-side storm list panel, draw-to-select polygon tool, per-address 14-year Weather History PDFs. Our honey hole heatmap is actually better than their manual swath-stacking approach.

**JobNimbus (CRM):** Pipeline cards have a fixed bottom row (days-in-status, task ratio, attachments, assignee avatar), 3 financial totals per column header, Insert Token mail merge in estimates, 4 calendar views with team color coding. Known weakness: blue-on-blue column colors with poor contrast.

**RoofLink (production):** Milestone-driven auto-advancing pipeline (not drag-and-drop), estimate approval auto-creates WOs + POs, templated install checklists with photo prompts per step, Roofle instant pricing widget ($350/mo). At $400/user/month, they're 10x+ our target price.

**Rooftops.ai (AI content):** Grid of content tool cards, prompt-driven generation, Solar Insights with suitability gauge, roof reports with expandable metric sections. AI Employees concept ($199/mo) for sales/marketing/estimating/insurance automation. Very cheap at $12/mo.

**Top 4 quick wins identified:** assignee avatars on pipeline cards, storm severity star ratings, lead source revenue chart, existing customer storm alerts.
